In @DataHaven_xyz  the camp isn’t a metaphor it’s a practice. We bring what’s valuable to the fire, share it and guard it together

Across time zones the camp stays lit an animator in Manila, a dev in Warsaw, a writer in Riga passing the torch 
Feedback lands kindly, effort compounds, and drafts become projects. Come for the story, stay for the craft. Leave the herd, join the Haven
